csv_project_name: AE for Ottawa Bldg SIGMA Department Relocation
csv_agency: State of Michigan Dept of Management & Budget
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Michigan Department of Technology, Management and Budget (DTMB) is seeking a proposal for Professional Services Contract (PSC) for Architectural and Engineering Services for the relocation of the SIGMA Department from a leased space to the first floor of the Ottawa Building in downtown Lansing, Michigan. The PSC will be responsible for developing design documents for plan review, bidding the project to a general contractor (Phase 500 Final Design) along Phase 600/700 Construction Administration services. The project will consist of the demolition of the existing office spaces and installation of new offices, conference rooms, and system furniture stations. The layout of the space has been developed by DTMBSFA-RED (is attached for reference) and the furniture design is underway with installation to be provided by DBI, Inc. Scope of work to include, but not limited to, verification of existing floor conditions, including walls, ceiling system, mechanical and electrical power distribution in the space, design for new space layout including hard wall offices and conference rooms, modifications to HVAC system distribution, electrical and data distribution system to support proposed new space and furniture layout, new configuration of light fixtures, relocated fire alarms and sprinklers, and construction documents (plans and specifications) suitable for review and approval by LARA.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Inspection Services, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
